links.rar, encrypted.rar and encrypted5.rar are libarchive's test files test_read_format_rar.rar, test_read_format_rar_encryption_data.rar and test_read_format_rar5_encrypted_filenames.rar, uudecoded and otherwise unchanged, from https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/c71118aa177a1a6a7a7ead35131e1659d8f807ff/libarchive/test, under libarchive's BSD 2-clause licence (LICENSE-libarchive). The other fixtures are ours: docs.7z and docs.tar.xz hold documents of the Knowledge Creator's corpus (pkg/knowledge/creator/testdata/corpus); locked.zip and sealed.zip were written with Info-ZIP's `zip -P`.
